title: Linking at the Eiffel
summary: you deleted me but agree with everything I say Happens to the best of us I deleted you? Blew me away I searched you Heart was instantly shattered I don't even know who you are We kiss When I discover myself #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
you deleted me
but agree with everything I say
Happens to the best of us

I deleted you?
Blew me away
I searched you
Heart was instantly shattered
I don't even know
who you are
We kiss
When I discover myself

#smallpoems
